text:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE: ALERT at 2026-03-15T20:03:21Z - custom metrics missing for HPA 'gpu-worker-hpa' in namespace 'inference'. GPU queue length high: 7.5k+, replicas at max(20). 5xx rate ↑ in frontdoor. Paging @oncall-sre.

maya (oncall-sre): oncall here. seeing huge queue growth, HPA stuck at 20/20 (cluster max). GPUs at 99% mem on existing pods. Confirming 503s reported by edge.

jun (ml-infra): checked prom-adapter logs, getting repeated failures fetching custom metrics. excerpt: 
```
E0307 12:03:21.123 prometheus-adapter: failed to fetch metrics: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc=connection refused
E0307 12:03:23.456 prometheus-adapter: error decoding response: EOF
kube-system/metrics-server: OOMKilled at 12:02:59
```

leah (prod-eng): customer impact - some long-running inferences are getting 503/429 throttles. EU cluster error rate ~7% last 10m. Sales flagged 2 escalations.

emma-cs: we already have 2 priority customer tickets open referencing timeouts. Need ETA and mitigation message.

maya (oncall-sre): mitigation plan (short): 1) emergency scale-up of reserved GPU pool (bump maxReplicas to 40), 2) evict non-urgent batch jobs from gpu-workers, 3) restart prometheus-adapter, 4) enable model-fallback routing to CPU small model for best-effort traffic. Jun/leah please coordinate.

jun (ml-infra): applying immediate patches. running: 
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-worker-hpa -n inference -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":40}}'
kubectl scale deploy/gpu-worker-prod -n inference --replicas=40
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter -n observability
```

ops-bot: Action started: provisioning additional GPU capacity in pool 'gpu-burst-emer' (requested 20 extra nodes). Estimated time ~6m.

jun (ml-infra): note: do not reboot metrics-server — it's OOMKilled. I'll bump resources then restart. patching resources now: 
```
kubectl set resources deploy/metrics-server -n kube-system --limits=memory=1Gi
kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-server -n kube-system
```

ops-bot: prometheus-adapter rollout complete (3 replicas). Adapter now returning custom metrics to kube-api.

maya (oncall-sre): HPA saw metrics and started scaling. new pods spinning up. queue length trending down from 7.5k -> 2.1k. routing fallback for small model enabled (traffic diverted ~12%).

leah (prod-eng): customers to notify: AcmeCorp (EU/US), BetaApp (EU). ETA for full recovery ~12min, will confirm.

tom (incident-manager): creating incident record INC-2026-0315-512, assigning SRE + ML infra + Prod Eng. I'll own customer comms draft unless someone else volunteers.

emma-cs: please confirm exact wording for CS. we can send 'We experienced elevated error rates due to a metrics pipeline outage causing autoscaling delays; mitigation in progress; ETA < 30m.' is that ok?

maya (oncall-sre): fine to send that. add that we've enabled temporary fallback to smaller models; no data exfiltration.

jun (ml-infra): monitoring metrics: GPU utilization dropping as new pods come online, prometheus-adapter shows stable responses. also bumped kube-system memory for metrics-server and restarted.

maya (oncall-sre): handing off to @jun for active monitoring. I'm offline after 20:40 UTC. Jun you'll be primary for next 60m. :white_check_mark:

jun (ml-infra): acknowledged, will watch queue and HPA behavior. will reopen page if trend reverses.

ops-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> degraded -> stable. Autoscale limit lifted to 40, current replicas 34, queue length 450.

maya (oncall-sre): action items to capture in postmortem: 1) remove single-point-of-failure in prom-adapter deploys; 2) increase liveness sensitivity and alerting for custom-metrics failures; 3) refine HPA maxReplica policies and emergent scaling broker; 4) add automated fallback route earlier in pipeline. I'll add these to incident doc.

tom (incident-manager): thanks all. I'll assemble timeline and publish to #incidents and link to the postmortem. Reopen if any regression.

ops-bot: Closing page if no regressions in 30m.

maya (oncall-sre): closing note: root cause appears to be prometheus-adapter crash loop + metrics-server OOM -> custom metrics blackhole -> HPA unable to scale past hard cap. Recovery path: resource bump + restart adapter + emergency maxRep increase + fallback routing. Postmortem to include timeline and mitigation knobs.

jun (ml-infra): leaving monitoring watch. will triage adapter logs after stabilizing to find failing scrape/label causing OOM.

leah (prod-eng): thanks team. will follow up on customer comms and postmortem actions.

tom (incident-manager): incident status: resolved->monitoring. closing thread in 30m if stable.
